configurations.value: baseline (stage 18-13, tested in ref. 1 = NASA TM X-3100); mod 1 = stators reset 2 deg open; mod 2 = reset stators plus rotating, circumferentially grooved stator hub
configurations.quote: An attempt was made to reduce the stator hub losses and thus improve stage performance by (1) resetting the stators 2 deg open and (2) using a rotating, grooved hub with the reset stators. These two modifications will be called mod 1 and mod 2, respectively, in this report.

baseline_geometry_tables.value: Tables IV (rotor 18) and V (stator 13) are the original (baseline) configuration; no separate geometry tables are printed for mod 1 or mod 2
baseline_geometry_tables.quote: The blade geometry for the original configuration is given in table IV for rotor 18 and in table V for stator 13.

mod1_stator_reset.quote: In mod 1 the stator blades were reset 2 deg open

mod2_hub.value: stationary stator hub liner replaced by a rotating, circumferentially grooved stator hub; stators also reset 2 deg open
mod2_hub.quote: in mod 2 the stationary stator hub liner was replaced with a rotating, circumferentially grooved stator hub (fig. 4). ... The circumferentially grooved hub reset stator configuration is designated as mod 2.

mod2_groove_depth.quote: The grooves were located under the stator blades and were approximately 0. 25 centimeter deep and 0.25 centimeter wide.

mod2_groove_width.quote: approximately 0. 25 centimeter deep and 0.25 centimeter wide

mod2_land_width.quote: The lands between the grooves were 0. 76 centimeter wide.

mod2_rotating_hub_extent.value: from rotor hub trailing edge to stator trailing edge
mod2_rotating_hub_extent.quote: For mod 2 (reset stator rotating grooved hub), the rotating hub extended from the rotor hub trailing edge to the stator trailing edge.

rotor_design_pressure_ratio.quote: The stage used in this investigation (stage 18-13) has a rotor designed for a pressure ratio of 2. 0 (constant from hub to tip) at a tip speed of 422 meters per second.

design_tip_speed.quote: a single-stage fan (stage 18-13) designed for a stage pressure ratio of 2.0 at a tip speed of 422 meters per second was tested (ref. 1)

stator_hub_inlet_design.quote: produces a high stator hub inlet Mach number (0.96) and high loading (diffusion factor = 0.66)

rotor_TE_to_stator_axial_gap.quote: the stator blade row was located approximately 3.0 centimeters downstream of the rotor trailing edge.

rotor_blade_count.quote: Not stated in TM X-3472 (design in ref. 1, NASA TM X-3100). Table IV SOLIDITY*2*pi*r_mean/CHORD gives 56.0 at every row (derived, not printed).

stator_blade_count.quote: Not stated in TM X-3472. Table V SOLIDITY*2*pi*r_mean/CHORD gives 62.0 (derived), consistent with the 5.8 deg stator passage traverse.

part_span_damper.quote: No damper is mentioned in the text; the Figure 3(a) photograph of rotor 18 shows no part-span shroud.

profile_type.quote: Not stated in the text of TM X-3472; Tables IV and V carry the MCA-program columns (KTC, ZTC transition point, X FACTOR, PHISS) as in the other Lewis MCA reports. The design is in ref. 1 (TM X-3100).

station3_traverse.quote: The combination probes downstream of the stator (station 3) were circumferentially traversed one stator blade passage (5.8 deg) counterclockwise from the nominal values shown.

survey_radial_positions.quote: Data were recorded at 11 radial positions for each speed and weight flow.

station_1_axial_position.quote: Fig. 2 flow path coordinates: a-2. 540 (a Instrumentation survey plane)

axial_reference.quote: Z axial distance referenced from rotor blade hub leading edge, cm

z_columns_definition.quote: axial distance to blade leading edge from inlet, cm

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet

air_angle_definition.value: angle between air velocity and axial direction
air_angle_definition.quote: beta air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction, deg

stator_failure.value: stator blade failure; only the maximum-flow point obtained for mod 2 at design speed
stator_failure.quote: Because of a stator failure, only the maximum flow data point was obtained for the mod 2 configuration at design speed.

tmx3100_rotor_blade_count.quote: The stage was designed for a tip solidity of 1. 7 for both rotor and stator. This resulted in 56 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 6 and 62 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 0.

tmx3100_stator_blade_count.quote: This resulted in 56 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 6 and 62 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 0.

tmx3100_rotor_aspect_ratio.quote: 56 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 6

tmx3100_stator_aspect_ratio.quote: 62 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 0

tmx3100_design_tip_solidity.quote: The stage was designed for a tip solidity of 1. 7 for both rotor and stator.

tmx3100_profile_type.quote: Both the rotor and stator used multiple-circular-arc blade shapes.

tmx3100_blade_sections.value: blade elements on conical surfaces, stacked on a line through their centers of gravity (TN D-5437 program)
tmx3100_blade_sections.quote: The blade geometry parameters are used in the blade coordinate program (ref. 6) to compute blade elements on conical surfaces passing through the blade. In this program the blade elements are then stacked on a line passing through their centers of gravity

tmx3100_rotor_tip_clearance.quote: The nonrotating radial tip clearance of the rotor was a nominal 0. 05 centimeter at ambient conditions.

tmx3100_rotor_damper_location.unit: percent span from outlet rotor tip (about)
tmx3100_rotor_damper_location.quote: Each rotor blade has a vibration damper located at about a 52 percent span from the outlet rotor tip.

tmx3100_rotor_damper_max_thickness.quote: The maximum thickness of the damper was 0.214 centimeter.

tmx3100_damper_not_in_design.value: damper losses not included in the rotor aerodynamic design
tmx3100_damper_not_in_design.quote: The losses associated with the damper were not included in the aerodynamic design of the rotor.

tmx3100_rotor_TE_to_stator_LE_hub_spacin.quote: The axial spacing between the rotor hub trailing edge and the stator hub leading edge was 3. 1 centimeters.

tmx3100_stator_hub_mounting.value: stator blade hubs seated on a rubber O-ring recessed in the inner casing
tmx3100_stator_hub_mounting.quote: The hubs of the stator blades were seated on a rub- ber O-ring which was circumferentially recessed in the inner casing.

tmx3100_design_weight_flow.quote: This stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 925 at a weight flow of 29. 5 kilograms per second (202 kg/sec/m2 of annulus area).

tmx3100_design_stage_pressure_ratio.quote: designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 925

tmx3100_design_tip_speed.quote: The de- sign tip speed was 422 meters per second.

tmx3100_rotor_design_pressure_ratio.quote: This rotor was designed for a radially constant total pressure ratio of 2. 0.

tmx3100_loss_model.value: profile loss from loss-diffusion factor correlations (rotor: ref. 4 = TM X-2379; stator: ref. 5 = CR-54621 MCA stator A) plus shock loss
tmx3100_loss_model.quote: Total loss is calculated within the program. It is based on a calculated shock loss (as related to the selected blade shape) and a profile loss. The profile losses used for this stage are based on loss-diffusion factor correla- tions, which include the data presented in reference 4 for the rotor and in reference 5 for the stator.

tmx3100_rotor_design_incidence_intent.value: minimum loss at zero suction-surface incidence
tmx3100_rotor_design_incidence_intent.quote: The rotor blades were designed for minimum loss to occur at zero inci- dence angle on the blade suction surface.

tmx3100_station3_traverse.quote: The combination probes downstream of the stator (station 3) were circumferentially traversed one stator blade passage (5. 8 deg) counterclockwise from the nominal values shown.

tmx3100_axial_reference.quote: Z axial distance referenced from rotor blade hub leading edge, cm
